memory.en: The Lord’s mercies are new every morning.
memory.yo: Àánú Olúwa jẹ́ tuntun ní gbogbo òwúrọ̀.

en: A new month gives us a chance to remember that God’s compassion has not run dry. Yesterday may have held loss or regret, but the Lord invites us to turn toward Him again.
Receive mercy with gratitude, make peace where you can, and take one honest step today. God’s faithfulness can steady you as you begin again.
yo: Oṣù tuntun ń rán wa létí pé àánú Ọlọ́run kò tán. Ó ṣeé ṣe kí àná ní ìpàdánù tàbí ohun tó ń bà ọ́ nínú jẹ́, ṣùgbọ́n Olúwa ń pè ọ láti tún yí sí Ọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
Fi ọpẹ́ gba àánú Rẹ̀, wá àlàáfíà níbi tí ó bá ṣeé ṣe, kí o sì gbé ìgbésẹ̀ òtítọ́ kan lónìí. Ìṣòtítọ́ Ọlọ́run lè mú ọ dúró bí o ṣe bẹ̀rẹ̀ tuntun.

quote.en: Mercy meets us at the first step.
quote.yo: Àánú ń pàdé wa ní ìgbésẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́.

declaration.en: May the Lord give every weary heart grace to begin again, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa fún gbogbo ọkàn tí ó rẹ̀ ní oore-ọ̀fẹ́ láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ tuntun, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Olùṣọ́-àgùntàn tó ń tọ́ wa sọ́nà

memory.en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
memory.yo: Olúwa ni Olùṣọ́-àgùntàn mi; n kò ní ṣaláìní ohun rere.

en: A shepherd knows the way and stays near the sheep. The Lord’s care does not mean every road is easy, but it means we do not have to choose our direction by fear alone.
Listen for His instruction in Scripture and seek wise counsel. Take the next faithful step, trusting that the Shepherd sees what lies ahead.
yo: Olùṣọ́-àgùntàn mọ ọ̀nà, ó sì sún mọ́ àwọn àgùntàn rẹ̀. Ìtọ́jú Olúwa kò túmọ̀ sí pé gbogbo ọ̀nà rọrùn, ṣùgbọ́n a kò nílò láti jẹ́ kí ẹ̀rù nìkan ló yan ọ̀nà wa.
Fetí sí ìtọ́sọ́nà Rẹ̀ nínú Ìwé Mímọ́, kí o sì wá ìmọ̀ràn lọ́dọ̀ ẹni ọlọ́gbọ́n. Gbé ìgbésẹ̀ ìgbọ́ràn tó kàn, kí o gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé Olùṣọ́-àgùntàn tó mọ ohun tó wà níwájú.

quote.en: The Shepherd’s presence gives courage for the road.
quote.yo: Wíwà Olùṣọ́-àgùntàn ń fún wa ní ìgboyà fún ìrìnàjò.

declaration.en: May the Lord lead our homes in paths of righteousness and peace, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa tọ́ àwọn ilé wa sí ọ̀nà òdodo àti àlàáfíà, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Those who wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
memory.yo: Àwọn tí ń retí Olúwa yóò rí agbára tuntun gbà.

en: Waiting can be tiring, especially when an answer matters deeply. Scripture does not shame the weary; it points them toward the God who does not faint or grow tired.
Tell the Lord what feels heavy, then ask for strength for the work in front of you. His help may come one day, one conversation, or one small step at a time.
yo: Ìdúró lè rẹni, pàápàá nígbà tí ìdáhùn kan ṣe pàtàkì sí wa. Ìwé Mímọ́ kò dá ẹni tó rẹ̀ lẹ́bi; ó tọ́ka sí Ọlọ́run tí kì í rẹ̀, tí kì í sì í sú.
Sọ ohun tó wuwo fún Olúwa, kí o sì bẹ̀ ẹ́ fún agbára fún iṣẹ́ tó wà níwájú rẹ. Ìrànlọ́wọ́ Rẹ̀ lè dé ní ìgbésẹ̀ kékeré kan lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

quote.en: God can renew what the wait has worn down.
quote.yo: Ọlọ́run lè tún ohun tí ìdúró ti rẹ̀ ṣe.

declaration.en: May the weary receive fresh strength and hope today, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí àwọn tí ó rẹ̀ gba agbára àti ìrètí tuntun lónìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: The Lord’s grace is sufficient; His strength is made perfect in weakness.
memory.yo: Oore-ọ̀fẹ́ Olúwa tó fún wa; agbára Rẹ̀ hàn nínú àìlera wa.

en: Paul asked for relief and received a promise of sustaining grace. God’s answer did not make Paul’s weakness imaginary; it gave him a place to depend on Christ.
You may ask for help and still be faithful. Bring your limits honestly to God, and let trusted people stand with you. His grace is present in the middle of need.
yo: Paulu bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ìtura, ó sì gba ìlérí oore-ọ̀fẹ́ tó ń gbé e ró. Ìdáhùn Ọlọ́run kò mú kí àìlera Paulu dà bí ohun tí kò sí; ó fún un ní ìdí láti gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé Kristi.
O lè bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́, ìgbàgbọ́ rẹ kò sì dín kù. Sọ ààlà rẹ fún Ọlọ́run, kí o sì jẹ́ kí àwọn ènìyàn tó ṣeé gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé dúró tì ọ́. Oore-ọ̀fẹ́ Rẹ̀ wà láàárín àìní.

quote.en: Grace is God’s help in the place we feel small.
quote.yo: Oore-ọ̀fẹ́ ni ìrànlọ́wọ́ Ọlọ́run níbi tí a ti rẹ̀wẹ̀sì.

declaration.en: May Christ’s strength uphold us in every weakness, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí agbára Kristi gbé wa ró nínú gbogbo àìlera, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise.
memory.yo: Ẹ wọ ẹnu-ọ̀nà Rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọpẹ́ àti ìyìn.

en: Ten people received healing, but one returned to give thanks. Gratitude helped him recognize the giver, not only the gift.
Name three ways God has helped you, even if your situation is still changing. Thankfulness does not deny hardship; it remembers that hardship is not the whole story.
yo: Àwọn ènìyàn mẹ́wàá rí ìwòsàn, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀kan padà láti dúpẹ́. Ìmoore ràn án lọ́wọ́ láti rántí Ẹni tó fún un ní ẹ̀bùn náà.
Sọ ọ̀nà mẹ́ta tí Ọlọ́run ti gbà ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́, bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ipò rẹ kò tíì yí padà pátápátá. Ìmoore kì í sẹ́ ìṣòro; ó ń rántí pé ìṣòro kì í ṣe gbogbo ìtàn wa.

quote.en: Gratitude keeps the Giver in view.
quote.yo: Ìmoore ń jẹ́ kí a máa rántí Ẹni tó ń fún wa.

declaration.en: May praise rise from our homes in every season, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìyìn máa ti inú àwọn ilé wa jáde ní gbogbo àkókò, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness.
memory.yo: Ẹ kọ́kọ́ wá ìjọba Ọlọ́run àti òdodo Rẹ̀.

en: Jesus spoke to people who worried about ordinary needs. He did not call those needs unimportant; He taught His followers to place God’s kingdom first and trust the Father with tomorrow.
Bring your plans and needs to God. Do the honest work you can do today, and refuse to let worry become your master.
yo: Jésù bá àwọn ènìyàn tó ń ṣàníyàn nípa àìní ojoojúmọ́ sọ̀rọ̀. Kò sọ pé àwọn àìní náà kò ṣe pàtàkì; Ó kọ́ àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀yìn Rẹ̀ láti kọ́kọ́ fi ìjọba Ọlọ́run sí ipò àkọ́kọ́.
Gbé ètò àti àìní rẹ lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run. Ṣe iṣẹ́ òtítọ́ tó wà lọ́wọ́ rẹ lónìí, má sì jẹ́ kí àníyàn di ọ̀gá rẹ.

quote.en: Put the Kingdom first; let tomorrow stay with God.
quote.yo: Fi ìjọba Ọlọ́run síwájú; fi ọ̀la sí ọwọ́ Rẹ̀.

declaration.en: May our choices honour God and bring peace to our homes, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí àwọn ìpinnu wa bu ọlá fún Ọlọ́run, kí wọ́n sì mú àlàáfíà wá sí ilé wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.en: God hears the one who asks
title.yo: Ọlọ́run ń gbọ́ ẹni tó ń bẹ̀bẹ̀

memory.en: Ask, seek, and knock; the Father gives good gifts.
memory.yo: Bẹ̀bẹ̀, wá, kí o sì kan ilẹ̀kùn; Baba ń fúnni ní ẹ̀bùn rere.

en: Jesus taught His disciples to pray simply and persistently. Prayer is not a performance; it is bringing our needs and our hearts to a Father who knows us.
Ask boldly, listen patiently, and keep seeking what is good. When words are hard to find, begin with the prayer Jesus taught.
yo: Jésù kọ́ àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀yìn Rẹ̀ láti máa gbàdúrà pẹ̀lú ìrọ̀rùn àti ìfaradà. Àdúrà kì í ṣe eré; ó jẹ́ gbígbé àìní àti ọkàn wa lọ sọ́dọ̀ Baba tó mọ̀ wá.
Bẹ̀bẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìgboyà, fetí sílẹ̀ pẹ̀lú sùúrù, kí o sì máa wá ohun rere. Tí ọ̀rọ̀ bá ṣòro fún ọ, bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àdúrà tí Jésù kọ́ wa.

quote.en: A simple prayer is still heard by the Father.
quote.yo: Baba ṣì ń gbọ́ àdúrà kékeré tí a fi tọkàntọkàn ṣe.

declaration.en: May our prayer lives grow steady and sincere, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìgbésí ayé àdúrà wa dúró ṣinṣin, kí ó sì jẹ́ ti òtítọ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: If we hope for what we do not see, we wait with patience.
memory.yo: Tí a bá ń retí ohun tí a kò tíì rí, a ń fi sùúrù dúró.

en: Waiting can make us question whether God has forgotten us. Scripture gives room for honest questions while calling us to keep watch and hold on to hope.
Continue to prepare, pray, and do the good that is yours to do. The answer may not have arrived, but God remains present in the waiting.
yo: Ìdúró lè mú ká máa bi ara wa pé bóyá Ọlọ́run ti gbàgbé wa. Ìwé Mímọ́ gba àyè fún ìbéèrè òtítọ́, ó sì pè wá láti máa ṣọ́ra kí a sì di ìrètí mú.
Máa múra sílẹ̀, máa gbàdúrà, kí o sì máa ṣe rere tó wà lọ́wọ́ rẹ. Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìdáhùn kò tíì dé, Ọlọ́run ṣì wà pẹ̀lú wa nígbà ìdúró.

quote.en: Waiting is a season to keep watch, not to give up.
quote.yo: Ìdúró jẹ́ àkókò ìṣọ́ra, kì í ṣe àkókò fífi ìrètí sílẹ̀.

declaration.en: May hope in the Lord keep us steadfast as we wait, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìrètí nínú Olúwa mú wa dúró ṣinṣin bí a ṣe ń dúró, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: If anyone lacks wisdom, let him ask God.
memory.yo: Bí ẹnikẹ́ni kò bá ní ọgbọ́n, kí ó béèrè lọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run.

en: James tells believers to ask God for wisdom. Wisdom is more than knowing facts; it helps us choose what is faithful, honest, and loving.
Before your next important choice, pause to pray, check Scripture, and seek counsel from someone trustworthy. God can guide a willing heart.
yo: Jákọ́bù sọ fún àwọn onígbàgbọ́ pé kí wọ́n bẹ Ọlọ́run fún ọgbọ́n. Ọgbọ́n ju mímọ̀ òtítọ́ lọ; ó ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti yan ohun tó jẹ́ ti ìgbọ́ràn, òtítọ́ àti ìfẹ́.
Kí o tó ṣe ìpinnu pàtàkì tó kàn, dúró díẹ̀, gbàdúrà, ṣàyẹ̀wò Ìwé Mímọ́, kí o sì wá ìmọ̀ràn lọ́dọ̀ ẹni tó ṣeé gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé. Ọlọ́run lè tọ́ ọkàn tó fẹ́ tẹ̀lé Ọ lọ́nà.

quote.en: Wisdom pauses to listen before it moves.
quote.yo: Ọgbọ́n máa ń dúró láti fetí sílẹ̀ kí ó tó gbé ìgbésẹ̀.

declaration.en: May the Lord give us wisdom for every choice before us, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa fún wa ní ọgbọ́n fún gbogbo ìpinnu tó wà níwájú wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Ọ̀rọ̀ tó ń mú ìwòsàn wá

memory.en: A soft answer turns away wrath.
memory.yo: Ìdáhùn pẹ̀lẹ́ máa ń mú ìbínú rọ̀.

en: Our words can calm a tense room or deepen a wound. Scripture calls us to speak truthfully and with kindness, especially when we are upset.
Before answering in anger, take a breath and ask what will build peace. Apologize where your words have hurt someone, and let grace guide what you say next.
yo: Ọ̀rọ̀ wa lè mú ìjà rọ̀ tàbí kí ó tún ọgbẹ́ kan jinlẹ̀ sí i. Ìwé Mímọ́ pè wá láti sọ òtítọ́ pẹ̀lú inú rere, pàápàá nígbà tí inú bá bí wa.
Kí o tó dáhùn ní ìbínú, mí sílẹ̀, kí o sì bi ara rẹ pé ọ̀rọ̀ wo ló máa mú àlàáfíà wá. Bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ìdáríjì níbi tí ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ ti dun ẹlòmíràn, kí o sì jẹ́ kí oore-ọ̀fẹ́ tọ́ ọ sọ́nà.

quote.en: Truth spoken with grace can make room for peace.
quote.yo: Òtítọ́ tí a fi oore-ọ̀fẹ́ sọ lè ṣí àyè fún àlàáfíà.

declaration.en: May our words strengthen, comfort, and honour others, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ọ̀rọ̀ wa fún àwọn ẹlòmíràn ní agbára àti ìtùnú, kí ó sì bu ọlá fún wọn, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as for the Lord.
memory.yo: Ohun gbogbo tí ẹ bá ṣe, ẹ fi gbogbo ọkàn yín ṣe é bí ẹni pé fún Olúwa ni.

en: Nehemiah prayed, examined the broken wall, and then organized the work. Faith gave him courage to begin; careful effort helped the people rebuild.
Offer your studies, business, job search, or household work to God. Choose one useful task and complete it with integrity, asking Him to bless the work of your hands.
yo: Nehémíà gbàdúrà, ó ṣàyẹ̀wò ògiri tó wó, ó sì ṣètò iṣẹ́ náà. Ìgbàgbọ́ fún un ní ìgboyà láti bẹ̀rẹ̀; iṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìṣọ́ra sì ràn àwọn ènìyàn lọ́wọ́ láti tún un kọ́.
Gbé ẹ̀kọ́, òwò, wíwá iṣẹ́ tàbí iṣẹ́ ilé rẹ lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run. Yan iṣẹ́ rere kan kí o sì parí rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú òtítọ́, kí o bẹ Olúwa pé kó bùkún iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ rẹ.

quote.en: Prayer gives courage; faithful hands take the next step.
quote.yo: Àdúrà ń fúnni ní ìgboyà; ọwọ́ olóòótọ́ sì ń gbé ìgbésẹ̀ tó kàn.

declaration.en: May the Lord establish honest work and make it a blessing to others, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa fi iṣẹ́ òtítọ́ múlẹ̀, kí ó sì sọ ọ́ di ìbùkún fún àwọn ẹlòmíràn, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Dárí jì bí Kristi ṣe dárí jì

memory.en: Be kind and tender-hearted, forgiving one another.
memory.yo: Ẹ ṣeun, ẹ ní àánú, kí ẹ sì máa dárí ji ara yín.

en: Forgiveness does not call wrong behaviour good or remove the need for wise boundaries. It places justice in God’s hands and refuses to let bitterness rule the heart.
Ask God for help with the next step: praying honestly, seeking counsel, or making a safe boundary. Healing can take time, and you do not have to walk through it alone.
yo: Dídáríjì kò túmọ̀ sí pé a pe ìwà búburú ní rere tàbí pé a kọ ààlà tó yẹ sílẹ̀. Ó túmọ̀ sí fífi ìdájọ́ sí ọwọ́ Ọlọ́run àti kí a má jẹ́ kí ìkorò ṣàkóso ọkàn wa.
Bẹ Ọlọ́run fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ìgbésẹ̀ tó kàn: gbígbàdúrà pẹ̀lú òtítọ́, wíwá ìmọ̀ràn, tàbí ṣíṣe ààlà tó dáàbò bo ọ. Ìwòsàn lè gba àkókò; o kò nílò láti dá nìkan rìn nínú rẹ̀.

quote.en: Forgiveness releases the heart to heal.
quote.yo: Ìdáríjì ń tú ọkàn sílẹ̀ kí ó lè rí ìwòsàn.

declaration.en: May God give us grace to forgive wisely and pursue peace, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run fún wa ní oore-ọ̀fẹ́ láti dárí jì pẹ̀lú ọgbọ́n àti láti lépa àlàáfíà, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Christ gives peace that the world cannot give.
memory.yo: Kristi fún wa ní àlàáfíà tí ayé kò lè fúnni.

en: The disciples were frightened by the storm, and Jesus was with them in the boat. Their fear was real; His presence was greater than what they could control.
Name the concern that feels like a storm today. Pray about it, take a sensible next step, and let someone trustworthy support you. Christ is present in the middle of trouble.
yo: Ìjì dé, ẹ̀rù sì bà àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀yìn, ṣùgbọ́n Jésù wà pẹ̀lú wọn nínú ọkọ̀ ojú omi náà. Ẹ̀rù wọn jẹ́ òtítọ́, ṣùgbọ́n wíwà Rẹ̀ ju ohun tí wọn lè ṣàkóso lọ.
Sọ ohun tó dà bí ìjì lónìí. Gbàdúrà nípa rẹ̀, ṣe ìgbésẹ̀ tó bójú mu, kí o sì jẹ́ kí ẹni tó ṣeé gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́. Kristi wà pẹ̀lú wa ní àárín ìṣòro.

quote.en: The storm is real, and so is Christ’s presence.
quote.yo: Ìjì náà wà, wíwà Kristi náà sì wà.

declaration.en: May the peace of Christ guard our hearts and homes, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí àlàáfíà Kristi ṣọ́ ọkàn àti ilé wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
memory.yo: Olúwa ni ìmọ́lẹ̀ àti ìgbàlà mi; ta ni èmi yóò bẹ̀rù?

en: David named the Lord as his light before describing the dangers around him. Faith helped him look toward God without pretending that trouble did not exist.
Bring one fear into the light through prayer and wise conversation. Ask God to show you the truth and the next safe step.
yo: Dáfídì pè Olúwa ní ìmọ́lẹ̀ rẹ̀ kí ó tó sọ nípa ewu tó yí i ká. Ìgbàgbọ́ ràn án lọ́wọ́ láti wo Ọlọ́run, láìṣe bí ẹni pé ìṣòro kò sí.
Gbé ẹ̀rù kan wá sí ìmọ́lẹ̀ nípasẹ̀ àdúrà àti ìjíròrò ọlọ́gbọ́n. Bẹ Ọlọ́run pé kó fi òtítọ́ àti ìgbésẹ̀ ààbò tó kàn hàn ọ.

quote.en: Light helps us see the next step.
quote.yo: Ìmọ́lẹ̀ ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti rí ìgbésẹ̀ tó kàn.

declaration.en: May the Lord illuminate our path and strengthen our hearts, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí ọ̀nà wa, kí ó sì fún ọkàn wa lókun, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Be strong and courageous; the Lord your God is with you.
memory.yo: Múra, kí o sì ní ìgboyà; Olúwa Ọlọ́run rẹ wà pẹ̀lú rẹ.

en: Joshua faced a new responsibility after Moses’ death. God’s command to be courageous came with the promise of His presence and the instruction to stay close to the Word.
You may not see the whole path. Ask God for courage to do the faithful thing you can see today, and remember that you are not walking alone.
yo: Jóṣúà dojú kọ ojúṣe tuntun lẹ́yìn ikú Mósè. Ọlọ́run pàṣẹ pé kó ní ìgboyà, Ó sì ṣèlérí wíwà Rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú rẹ̀, Ó tún ní kó sún mọ́ Ọ̀rọ̀ Rẹ̀.
Ó ṣeé ṣe kí o má rí gbogbo ọ̀nà náà. Bẹ Ọlọ́run fún ìgboyà láti ṣe ohun ìgbọ́ràn tó wà níwájú rẹ lónìí, kí o sì rántí pé ìwọ kò dá rìn.

quote.en: Courage grows when we remember who walks with us.
quote.yo: Ìgboyà ń pọ̀ sí i bí a ṣe rántí ẹni tó ń bá wa rìn.

declaration.en: May God strengthen us to obey Him with courage today, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run fún wa lókun láti fi ìgboyà ṣègbọràn sí i lónìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: God will supply every need according to His riches in Christ.
memory.yo: Ọlọ́run yóò pèsè gbogbo àìní wa nípasẹ̀ Kristi.

en: Paul learned contentment in seasons of plenty and need. He also thanked the believers who shared with him. God’s provision can come through daily bread, wise planning, and the kindness of others.
Tell God what your household needs. Make a careful plan, ask for help when needed, and share what you can with someone else.
yo: Paulu kọ́ bí a ṣe lè ní ìtẹ́lọ́rùn nígbà ọ̀pọ̀ àti nígbà àìní. Ó tún dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn onígbàgbọ́ tó pín ohun tí wọ́n ní pẹ̀lú rẹ̀. Ìpèsè Ọlọ́run lè dé nípasẹ̀ oúnjẹ ojoojúmọ́, ètò ọlọ́gbọ́n àti inú rere àwọn ènìyàn.
Sọ àìní ilé rẹ fún Ọlọ́run. Ṣètò pẹ̀lú ìṣọ́ra, bẹ̀rẹ̀ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ bí ó bá yẹ, kí o sì pín ohun tí o lè pín pẹ̀lú ẹlòmíràn.

quote.en: Provision is received with gratitude and stewarded with wisdom.
quote.yo: A ń fi ọpẹ́ gba ìpèsè, a sì ń fi ọgbọ́n lò ó.

declaration.en: May God provide for our needs and teach us faithful stewardship, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run pèsè fún àìní wa, kí ó sì kọ́ wa láti máa lo ìbùkún pẹ̀lú òtítọ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.
memory.yo: Ṣọ́ ọkàn rẹ, nítorí láti inú rẹ ni ìgbésí ayé ti ń jáde.

en: The writer of Proverbs connects the heart with the direction of life. What we listen to, dwell on, and practise can shape our choices.
Make room for Scripture, rest, and honest friendship. Step away from what repeatedly feeds fear or bitterness, and ask God to renew your thoughts.
yo: Òǹkọ̀wé Òwe so ọkàn pọ̀ mọ́ ọ̀nà ìgbésí ayé. Ohun tí a ń gbọ́, ohun tí a ń ronú lé lórí àti ohun tí a ń ṣe lè nípa lórí àwọn ìpinnu wa.
Fún Ìwé Mímọ́, ìsinmi àti ìbáṣepọ̀ òtítọ́ ní àyè. Yàgò fún ohun tó ń mú ẹ̀rù tàbí ìkorò pọ̀ sí i léraléra, kí o sì bẹ Ọlọ́run pé kó tún èrò rẹ ṣe.

quote.en: What we let into the heart shapes the road ahead.
quote.yo: Ohun tí a bá jẹ́ kó wọ ọkàn wa ń nípa lórí ọ̀nà iwájú.

declaration.en: May God keep our hearts rooted in truth, peace, and love, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run mú ọkàn wa dúró nínú òtítọ́, àlàáfíà àti ìfẹ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Through love, serve one another.
memory.yo: Nípasẹ̀ ìfẹ́, ẹ máa sin ara yín.

en: Jesus washed His disciples’ feet and showed that greatness in God’s kingdom looks like humble service. Love becomes visible through attention and practical care.
Notice one person who could use support today. Offer help respectfully, without expecting praise, and remember that every act of service matters to God.
yo: Jésù wẹ ẹsẹ̀ àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀yìn Rẹ̀, Ó sì fi hàn pé ìrẹ̀lẹ̀ àti sísin ni ń fi títóbi hàn nínú ìjọba Ọlọ́run. Ìfẹ́ máa ń hàn nínú àkíyèsí àti ìrànlọ́wọ́ tó ṣeé fọwọ́ kàn.
Ṣàkíyèsí ẹnìkan tó nílò ìrànlọ́wọ́ lónìí. Ràn án lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú ìbọ̀wọ̀, láìretí ìyìn, kí o sì rántí pé Ọlọ́run mọ iṣẹ́ rere gbogbo.

quote.en: Love takes the shape of service.
quote.yo: Ìfẹ́ máa ń hàn nínú sísin.

declaration.en: May our church serve our neighbours with humility and love, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìjọ wa máa fi ìrẹ̀lẹ̀ àti ìfẹ́ sin àwọn aládùúgbò wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Ìtùnú fún àwọn tó ń ṣọ̀fọ̀

memory.en: The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart.
memory.yo: Olúwa sún mọ́ àwọn tí ọkàn wọn bàjẹ́.

en: When Lazarus died, Jesus met Mary and Martha in their grief. He wept with them before raising Lazarus. Their sorrow was not met with shame or a quick dismissal.
Bring your grief to God honestly. Let trusted people sit with you, and seek professional support if the pain becomes hard to carry. The Lord is near to the brokenhearted.
yo: Nígbà tí Lásárù kú, Jésù pàdé Màríà àti Mátà nínú ọ̀fọ̀ wọn. Ó sunkún pẹ̀lú wọn kí Ó tó jí Lásárù dìde. Kò fi ìtìjú bo ìbànújẹ́ wọn, kò sì fojú fo ó.
Gbé ọ̀fọ̀ rẹ lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run pẹ̀lú òtítọ́. Jẹ́ kí àwọn tó ṣeé gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé dúró tì ọ́, kí o sì wá ìrànlọ́wọ́ ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n bí ẹrù bá pọ̀ jù. Olúwa sún mọ́ àwọn tí ọkàn wọn bàjẹ́.

quote.en: The Lord draws near; you do not have to hide your tears.
quote.yo: Olúwa sún mọ́ ọ; o kò nílò láti fi omijé rẹ pamọ́.

declaration.en: May God comfort every grieving person and surround them with loving support, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run tù gbogbo ẹni tó ń ṣọ̀fọ̀ nínú, kí ó sì fi àwọn olùrànlọ́wọ́ onífẹ̀ẹ́ yí wọn ká, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: A pè wá sí ìwà mímọ́

memory.en: Be holy, because I am holy.
memory.yo: Ẹ jẹ́ mímọ́, nítorí mímọ́ ni Èmi.

en: Holiness is a response to God’s character and grace. It touches ordinary choices: what we say, how we treat people, and what we do when nobody is watching.
Ask the Holy Spirit to show you one area where you need to turn back to God. Receive forgiveness, make things right, and keep walking in obedience.
yo: Ìwà mímọ́ jẹ́ ìdáhùn sí ìwà Ọlọ́run àti oore-ọ̀fẹ́ Rẹ̀. Ó kan àwọn ìpinnu ojoojúmọ́: ọ̀rọ̀ wa, bí a ṣe ń bá ènìyàn lò, àti ohun tí a ń ṣe nígbà tí kò sí ẹni tó ń wò wá.
Bẹ Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́ pé kó fi apá kan tó yẹ kí o yí padà sí Ọlọ́run hàn ọ. Gba ìdáríjì, ṣe àtúnṣe, kí o sì máa tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìgbọ́ràn.

quote.en: Holiness is faithfulness in the life we live each day.
quote.yo: Ìwà mímọ́ ni jíjẹ́ olóòótọ́ nínú ìgbésí ayé ojoojúmọ́.

declaration.en: May the Lord cleanse our hearts and establish us in holiness, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa wẹ ọkàn wa mọ́, kí ó sì fi wa múlẹ̀ nínú ìwà mímọ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.en: Teach us to use our days well
title.yo: Kọ́ wa láti lo ọjọ́ wa dáadáa

memory.en: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
memory.yo: Kọ́ wa láti mọ iye ọjọ́ wa, kí a lè ní ọkàn ọlọ́gbọ́n.

en: Life is a gift, and our days are limited. The psalmist asks God for wisdom so that we may live with purpose rather than drift through each day.
Set aside time for what matters: prayer, family, useful work, rest, and kindness. You do not have to do everything today; choose the faithful task in front of you.
yo: Ìgbésí ayé jẹ́ ẹ̀bùn, ọjọ́ wa sì ní ààlà. Onísáàmù bẹ Ọlọ́run fún ọgbọ́n kí a lè gbé pẹ̀lú ète, dípò kí ọjọ́ wa máa lọ láìní ètò.
Ya àkókò sọ́tọ̀ fún ohun tó ṣe pàtàkì: àdúrà, ẹbí, iṣẹ́ tó wúlò, ìsinmi àti inú rere. O kò nílò láti ṣe ohun gbogbo lónìí; yan iṣẹ́ ìgbọ́ràn tó wà níwájú rẹ.

quote.en: A wise day is shaped by faithful choices.
quote.yo: Ìpinnu ìgbọ́ràn ló ń ṣe ọjọ́ ọlọ́gbọ́n.

declaration.en: May God help us spend our days in wisdom and love, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti lo ọjọ́ wa pẹ̀lú ọgbọ́n àti ìfẹ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, continue in prayer.
memory.yo: Ẹ máa yọ̀ nínú ìrètí, ẹ ní sùúrù nínú ìpọ́njú, ẹ sì máa gbàdúrà.

en: Paul joins hope, patience, and prayer together. Patience is not pretending that hardship is easy; it is continuing to do what is good while trusting God through the hard season.
Ask for strength to stay kind and steady today. If you need support, speak to someone you trust instead of carrying everything in silence.
yo: Paulu so ìrètí, sùúrù àti àdúrà pọ̀. Sùúrù kì í ṣe fífi ojú fo ìṣòro; ó jẹ́ ṣíṣe rere nígbà tí a ṣì ń gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé Ọlọ́run láàárín àkókò líle.
Bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún agbára láti máa ní inú rere àti láti dúró ṣinṣin lónìí. Bí o bá nílò ìrànlọ́wọ́, bá ẹni tó o gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé sọ̀rọ̀ dípò kí o máa ru gbogbo ẹrù rẹ ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́.

quote.en: Hope gives patience a reason to keep going.
quote.yo: Ìrètí ń fún sùúrù ní ìdí láti tẹ̀síwájú.

declaration.en: May God keep our hope alive and make us steadfast in prayer, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run pa ìrètí wa mọ́, kí ó sì mú wa dúró ṣinṣin nínú àdúrà, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.en: Do not grow weary in doing good
title.yo: Má ṣe rẹ̀ nínú ṣíṣe rere

memory.en: Let us not grow weary in doing good; in due season we shall reap.
memory.yo: Ẹ má ṣe rẹ̀ nínú ṣíṣe rere; ní àkókò rẹ̀ a ó ká èso.

en: Some good work seems unseen for a long time: caring for family, studying faithfully, serving at church, or choosing honesty when a shortcut looks easier.
God sees the labour of love. Rest when you need to, ask for help, and return to the good work with renewed strength.
yo: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí iṣẹ́ rere kan má hàn sí ènìyàn fún ìgbà pípẹ́: títọ́jú ẹbí, kíkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ pẹ̀lú ìtara, sísìn nínú ìjọ tàbí yíyan òtítọ́ nígbà tí ọ̀nà abuja bá dà bí ẹni pé ó rọrùn.
Ọlọ́run rí iṣẹ́ ìfẹ́ rẹ. Sinmi nígbà tó yẹ, bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́, kí o sì padà sí iṣẹ́ rere pẹ̀lú agbára tuntun.

quote.en: Faithfulness matters even before the harvest is visible.
quote.yo: Jíjẹ́ olóòótọ́ ṣe pàtàkì kí èso tó hàn.

declaration.en: May God strengthen every person who keeps doing good, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run fún gbogbo ẹni tó ń bá a lọ ní ṣíṣe rere lókun, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.en: Trust the Lord with your path
title.yo: Fi ọ̀nà rẹ lé Olúwa lọ́wọ́

memory.en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and He will direct your paths.
memory.yo: Fi gbogbo ọkàn rẹ gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé Olúwa; yóò tọ́ ọ̀nà rẹ̀.

en: Trusting God does not mean refusing to think or plan. Proverbs calls us to seek Him in every part of life and let His wisdom correct our own understanding.
Bring your decision to God, gather the facts, and seek wise counsel. Move forward with humility, ready to adjust when truth becomes clearer.
yo: Gbígbẹ́kẹ̀ lé Ọlọ́run kò túmọ̀ sí pé a kò ronú tàbí ṣètò. Òwe pè wá láti máa wá Ọlọ́run nínú gbogbo apá ìgbésí ayé, kí ọgbọ́n Rẹ̀ sì tọ́ èrò wa sọ́nà.
Gbé ìpinnu rẹ lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run, kó ìsọfúnni jọ, kí o sì wá ìmọ̀ràn ọlọ́gbọ́n. Tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ìrẹ̀lẹ̀, kí o sì múra láti ṣàtúnṣe bí òtítọ́ bá ṣe túbọ̀ hàn.

quote.en: Trust moves forward while remaining teachable.
quote.yo: Ìgbẹ́kẹ̀lé ń tẹ̀síwájú, ó sì ṣì setán láti kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́.

declaration.en: May God make our paths clear and our choices honourable, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run mú ọ̀nà wa ṣe kedere, kí àwọn ìpinnu wa sì jẹ́ ọlá fún Un, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Jẹ́ kí iná lórí pẹpẹ máa jó

memory.en: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning; it must not go out.
memory.yo: A gbọdọ̀ máa tọ́jú iná lórí pẹpẹ kí ó má bàa kú.

en: The priests tended the altar regularly. Jesus also taught His followers to remain watchful and prepared. Our walk with God grows through repeated, faithful attention.
Set a real moment aside for prayer and Scripture today. Do not wait until a crisis to speak with God; bring Him the ordinary parts of life too.
yo: Àwọn àlùfáà máa ń tọ́jú pẹpẹ déédéé. Jésù tún kọ́ àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀yìn Rẹ̀ láti máa ṣọ́ra àti láti múra sílẹ̀. Ìrìn wa pẹ̀lú Ọlọ́run ń dàgbà nípasẹ̀ ìfọkànsìn ojoojúmọ́.
Ya àkókò gidi sọ́tọ̀ fún àdúrà àti Ìwé Mímọ́ lónìí. Má dúró de ìṣòro kí o tó bá Ọlọ́run sọ̀rọ̀; mú àwọn ohun ojoojúmọ́ rẹ wá sọ́dọ̀ Rẹ̀ náà.

quote.en: A tended altar is a watchful heart.
quote.yo: Pẹpẹ tí a ń tọ́jú ń ṣàpẹẹrẹ ọkàn tó ń ṣọ́ra.

declaration.en: May fresh zeal for prayer and holiness rise in our homes, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìtara tuntun fún àdúrà àti ìwà mímọ́ dìde nínú àwọn ilé wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.en: Keep the unity of the Spirit

memory.en: Make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through peace.
memory.yo: Ẹ ṣe gbogbo ipa láti pa ìṣọ̀kan Ẹ̀mí mọ́ nípasẹ̀ àlàáfíà.

en: The early church grew through teaching, fellowship, shared meals, and prayer. Unity did not mean everyone was identical; it meant they belonged to Christ and cared for one another.
Encourage someone in the church, listen before judging, and help carry a practical burden. Ask God to make Mount Zion a place where people are seen and supported.
yo: Ìjọ àkọ́kọ́ dàgbà nípasẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́, ìbáṣepọ̀, pípín oúnjẹ àti àdúrà. Ìṣọ̀kan kò túmọ̀ sí pé gbogbo ènìyàn jọra; ó túmọ̀ sí pé gbogbo wọn jẹ́ ti Kristi, wọ́n sì ń bójú tó ara wọn.
Fún ẹnìkan ní ìṣírí nínú ìjọ, fetí sílẹ̀ kí o tó dájọ́, kí o sì ran ẹlòmíràn lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú iṣẹ́ tó ṣeé ṣe. Bẹ Ọlọ́run pé kó jẹ́ kí Mount Zion jẹ́ ibi tí a ti ń rí ènìyàn, tí a sì ń ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́.

quote.en: Unity grows where people listen, pray, and help.
quote.yo: Ìṣọ̀kan ń dàgbà níbi tí ènìyàn ti ń fetí sílẹ̀, gbàdúrà, tí wọ́n sì ń ran ara wọn lọ́wọ́.

declaration.en: May love, unity, and compassionate service increase among us, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìfẹ́, ìṣọ̀kan àti sísin pẹ̀lú àánú pọ̀ sí i láàárín wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God.
memory.yo: Ṣe òdodo, nífẹ̀ẹ́ àánú, kí o sì rìn pẹ̀lú ìrẹ̀lẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Ọlọ́run rẹ.

en: Micah reminds God’s people that worship must shape how they treat others. Jesus’ story of the Samaritan shows mercy crossing social boundaries and becoming practical help.
Look beyond convenience today. Treat someone fairly, offer help where you can, and walk humbly rather than seeking attention for the good you do.
yo: Míkà rán àwọn ènìyàn Ọlọ́run létí pé ìjọsìn gbọ́dọ̀ nípa lórí bí wọ́n ṣe ń bá àwọn ẹlòmíràn lò. Ìtàn Jésù nípa ará Samáríà fi hàn pé àánú ń kọjá ààlà, ó sì máa ń di ìrànlọ́wọ́ tó ṣeé fọwọ́ kàn.
Wo kọjá ohun tó rọrùn fún ọ lónìí. Bójú tó ẹlòmíràn pẹ̀lú òdodo, ran án lọ́wọ́ bí o bá lè ṣe é, kí o sì rìn pẹ̀lú ìrẹ̀lẹ̀ láìwá ìyìn fún iṣẹ́ rere rẹ.

quote.en: Mercy becomes visible through practical care.
quote.yo: Àánú máa ń hàn nínú ìrànlọ́wọ́ tó ṣeé fọwọ́ kàn.

declaration.en: May God make us people who act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run sọ wá di ènìyàn tó ń ṣe òdodo, tí ó nífẹ̀ẹ́ àánú, tí ó sì ń rìn pẹ̀lú ìrẹ̀lẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: God promises to restore the years that were lost.
memory.yo: Ọlọ́run ṣèlérí láti mú ohun tí ọdún tó kọjá ti bàjẹ́ padà.

en: Joel spoke to a people who had endured loss. God’s promise of restoration gave them a reason to hope, while calling them to return to Him with sincere hearts.
Some losses cannot be replaced in the same way, but God can lead us into healing, new purpose, and support. Ask for help with one next step toward rebuilding.
yo: Joẹli bá àwọn ènìyàn tó ti fara da ìpàdánù sọ̀rọ̀. Ìlérí Ọlọ́run nípa ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò fún wọn ní ìdí láti ní ìrètí, ó sì pè wọ́n láti padà sọ́dọ̀ Rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọkàn òtítọ́.
Àwọn ohun kan tí a pàdánù lè má padà ní ọ̀nà kan náà, ṣùgbọ́n Ọlọ́run lè tọ́ wa sínú ìwòsàn, ète tuntun àti ìrànlọ́wọ́. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ìgbésẹ̀ kan sí àtúnkọ́.

quote.en: Restoration may begin with one small rebuilt place.
quote.yo: Ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò lè bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àtúnkọ́ ohun kékeré kan.

declaration.en: May God restore hope and strengthen every household rebuilding after loss, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Ọlọ́run mú ìrètí padà, kí ó sì fún gbogbo ilé tó ń tún ara wọn kọ́ lẹ́yìn ìpàdánù lókun, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Ìgbàgbọ́ tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ nípasẹ̀ ìfẹ́

memory.en: The faith that matters is faith working through love.
memory.yo: Ìgbàgbọ́ tó ṣe pàtàkì ni èyí tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ nípasẹ̀ ìfẹ́.

en: James asks what good words are if we ignore a person’s practical need. Faith is not earned by good works, but living faith expresses itself through love and care.
Let your belief shape one action today: share a meal, encourage someone, keep a promise, or help with a task. Small acts can carry Christ’s kindness.
yo: Jákọ́bù béèrè ohun tí ọ̀rọ̀ rere wúlò fún bí a bá kọbi ara sí àìní gidi ẹlòmíràn. A kì í fi iṣẹ́ rere ra ìgbàlà, ṣùgbọ́n ìgbàgbọ́ alààyè máa ń fi ìfẹ́ àti ìtọ́jú hàn.
Jẹ́ kí ìgbàgbọ́ rẹ darí ìṣe kan lónìí: pín oúnjẹ, fún ẹnìkan ní ìṣírí, pa ìlérí rẹ mọ́, tàbí ran ẹlòmíràn lọ́wọ́. Ìṣe kékeré lè gbé inú rere Kristi lọ sí ọ̀dọ̀ ènìyàn.

quote.en: Living faith leaves the mark of love.
quote.yo: Ìgbàgbọ́ alààyè máa ń fi àmì ìfẹ́ sílẹ̀.

declaration.en: May our faith become visible through generous and loving actions, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìgbàgbọ́ wa hàn nípasẹ̀ ìṣe ìfẹ́ àti ìfúnni pẹ̀lú inú rere, ní orúkọ Jésù.

title.yo: Múra sílẹ̀, kí o sì máa ṣọ́ra

memory.en: Be ready, for the Son of Man comes at an hour you do not expect.
memory.yo: Ẹ múra sílẹ̀, nítorí Ọmọ Ènìyàn yóò dé ní àkókò tí ẹ kò retí.

focus.yo: gbígbé ayé pẹ̀lú ìmúrasílẹ̀ fún Kristi

en: Jesus’ parable of the ten bridesmaids calls His followers to readiness. The wise prepared before the bridegroom arrived; readiness was built through choices made earlier.
Keep your lamp burning through daily faithfulness: pray, obey, make peace, and serve. Do not delay the good that God is asking you to do today.
yo: Òwe Jésù nípa àwọn wúńdíá mẹ́wàá pè àwọn ọmọ-ẹ̀yìn Rẹ̀ láti máa múra sílẹ̀. Àwọn ọlọ́gbọ́n múra ṣáájú kí ọkọ ìyàwó tó dé; àwọn ìpinnu wọn ṣáájú ló mú kí wọ́n múra.
Jẹ́ kí fìtílà rẹ máa jó nípasẹ̀ ìgbọ́ràn ojoojúmọ́: gbàdúrà, ṣègbọràn, wá àlàáfíà, kí o sì máa sìn. Má ṣe dá iṣẹ́ rere tí Ọlọ́run fẹ́ kí o ṣe lónìí dúró.

quote.en: Readiness is built in ordinary daily faithfulness.
quote.yo: Ìmúrasílẹ̀ ń dàgbà nípasẹ̀ ìgbọ́ràn ojoojúmọ́.

declaration.en: May the Lord keep our lamps burning and our lives ready, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí Olúwa jẹ́ kí fìtílà wa máa jó, kí ó sì mú ìgbésí ayé wa wà ní ìmúrasílẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.

memory.en: Give thanks in every circumstance; this is God’s will in Christ.
memory.yo: Ẹ máa dúpẹ́ ní gbogbo ipò; èyí ni ìfẹ́ Ọlọ́run nínú Kristi.

en: At the end of this month, pause and remember where God helped you: a need met, a difficult conversation, strength to continue, or a person who stood beside you.
Give thanks for what you have received, place unfinished concerns in God’s hands, and enter the next month with a willing heart. Gratitude helps us notice grace along the way.
yo: Ní òpin oṣù yìí, dúró díẹ̀ kí o sì rántí ibi tí Ọlọ́run ti ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́: àìní tí a pèsè, ìjíròrò tó le, agbára láti tẹ̀síwájú, tàbí ẹni tó dúró tì ọ́.
Dúpẹ́ fún ohun tí o ti rí gbà, fi àwọn ọ̀ràn tí kò tíì yanjú sí ọwọ́ Ọlọ́run, kí o sì wọ oṣù tó ń bọ̀ pẹ̀lú ọkàn tó ṣetán. Ìmoore ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti rí oore-ọ̀fẹ́ lójú ọ̀nà.

quote.en: Thanksgiving helps us recognize grace along the way.
quote.yo: Ìmoore ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti rí oore-ọ̀fẹ́ lójú ọ̀nà.

declaration.en: May gratitude and renewed hope fill our homes as this month closes, in Jesus’ name.
declaration.yo: Kí ìmoore àti ìrètí tuntun kún inú àwọn ilé wa bí oṣù yìí ṣe ń parí, ní orúkọ Jésù.

en.title: Keep the fire burning
en.verse: Leviticus 6:13 — The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
message: A flame does not remain bright by accident. The priest tended the altar each day, and Jesus’ parable of the lamps reminds us to live ready for His coming. In the same way, our walk with God needs daily attention. We pray, read the Word, turn away from sin, and obey the light we have received.

Do not wait for a crisis before returning to the place of prayer. A few faithful moments with God today can shape your decisions, your words, and your response to others. Ask the Lord to expose anything that has made your heart cold. Bring it to Him honestly. The God who calls us to watchfulness also gives grace to continue.
en.quote: A tended altar is a ready heart.
en.declaration: May fresh zeal for prayer and holiness arise in our homes, in Jesus’ name.
morning: Father, rekindle my love for Your Word, in Jesus’ name.
Every distraction drawing me away from Your presence, lose your power, in Jesus’ name.
Lord, give me grace to obey You today, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Father, forgive every careless word and action of today, in Jesus’ name.
Let my heart remain watchful and ready, in Jesus’ name.
May the fire of Your presence never go out in my home, in Jesus’ name.

en.title: When the way seems closed
en.verse: Exodus 14:14 — The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
message: Israel saw the sea ahead and an army behind. Their fear was real, but the Lord had not abandoned them. The command to move forward came before the road could be seen. God made a path where His people could not make one for themselves.

A closed door can make us panic or reach for an unwise escape. Bring the matter to God first. Then do the next honest thing that is within your hands. His help may come through courage, counsel, provision, or an unexpected opening. Let fear speak less loudly than His promise.
en.quote: The Lord can make a path before you can see one.
en.declaration: May every barrier before God’s purpose give way by His power, in Jesus’ name.
morning: O Lord, arise and scatter fear before me, in Jesus’ name.
Every altar of delay against my progress, be dismantled, in Jesus’ name.
Father, show me the next faithful step, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Lord, guard my heart from panic and rash choices, in Jesus’ name.
Let every opposition to Your purpose be overturned, in Jesus’ name.
I rest in Your care tonight, in Jesus’ name.

en.title: A heart made clean
en.verse: Psalm 51:10 — Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
message: David did not hide behind excuses when he prayed for mercy. He acknowledged his sin and asked God to renew him from within. Holiness begins with an honest heart before God, not an impressive appearance before people.

The Lord invites us to confess, turn, and receive forgiveness. Ask the Spirit to show you the habits that weaken your obedience. Make amends where you have wronged someone. Resist the voice that says change is impossible. God can form new desires and establish a right spirit in us.
en.quote: A clean heart is worth more than a polished image.
en.declaration: May the Lord cleanse our hearts and establish us in holiness, in Jesus’ name.
morning: Father, search my heart and reveal what displeases You, in Jesus’ name.
Every bondage to secret sin, be broken by the power of Christ, in Jesus’ name.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Lord, forgive where I fell short today, in Jesus’ name.
Give me courage to make things right, in Jesus’ name.
Renew a steadfast spirit within me, in Jesus’ name.

en.title: Strength in the waiting
en.verse: Isaiah 40:31 — But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.
message: Waiting can feel like standing still while everyone else moves ahead. Yet Scripture describes waiting on the Lord as a place where strength is renewed. We continue to pray, prepare, serve, and trust God with what we cannot control.

Do not measure His nearness by the speed of an answer. The delay may be painful, and you can tell Him so. Ask for endurance without bitterness and wisdom for the work of today. Let each small act of faithfulness remind you that your story is still in His hands.
en.quote: Waiting with God is never wasted.
en.declaration: May weary hearts receive renewed strength today, in Jesus’ name.
morning: Every spirit of discouragement, lose your hold over me, in Jesus’ name.
Father, renew my strength as I wait on You, in Jesus’ name.
Let hope rise again in my heart, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Lord, quiet my anxious thoughts, in Jesus’ name.
Every power pushing me into harmful shortcuts, be scattered, in Jesus’ name.
Teach me to trust Your timing, in Jesus’ name.

en.title: The power of agreement
en.verse: Matthew 18:20 — For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
message: The early believers gave themselves to teaching, fellowship, breaking bread, and prayer. Their shared life strengthened them. God did not design His people to carry every burden alone. We need a community that worships together and tells the truth in love.

Reach out to someone in the church today. Encourage a person who has been absent. Pray for another family by name. A congregation grows stronger when each member brings compassion and practical help, not only when everyone attends a gathering. Ask the Lord to make Mount Zion a home where people are seen and supported.
en.quote: A praying church makes room for every burden.
en.declaration: May love, unity, and the power of God increase among us, in Jesus’ name.
morning: Every seed of division in our church, be uprooted, in Jesus’ name.
Father, bind our hearts together in love, in Jesus’ name.
Make me a faithful encourager today, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Lord, remember those who are lonely or hurting, in Jesus’ name.
Let our prayers produce compassion and action, in Jesus’ name.
Establish peace in every home represented in our church, in Jesus’ name.

en.title: Mercy for a new morning
en.verse: Lamentations 3:23 — They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
message: Yesterday may have carried loss, disappointment, or decisions you regret. The prophet remembered his affliction, but he also called to mind the Lord’s steadfast mercy. He found a reason to hope in the middle of hardship.

A new morning does not erase every consequence. It does give us another opportunity to turn toward God and take a faithful step. Receive His mercy with gratitude. Seek reconciliation where needed. Ask for help where the burden is heavy. The Lord remains faithful while He teaches us to begin again.
en.quote: Mercy meets us before the day’s work begins.
en.declaration: May the mercy of God speak over every troubled home today, in Jesus’ name.
morning: Father, thank You for mercy that is new this morning, in Jesus’ name.
Every voice of condemnation silencing my prayer, be broken, in Jesus’ name.
Guide my steps into obedience today, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Lord, help me release the weight I cannot carry, in Jesus’ name.
Let mercy and healing enter strained relationships, in Jesus’ name.
Keep my hope alive in Your faithfulness, in Jesus’ name.

en.title: Work with faithful hands
en.verse: Psalm 90:17 — And establish thou the work of our hands upon us.
message: Nehemiah prayed, examined the broken walls, and then called the people to build. Faith did not remove the need for planning and work. It gave him courage to begin the task before him.

Bring your work, studies, business, and search for employment to God. Ask Him for honest opportunities and diligence. Identify one useful action you can take today: prepare, learn, apply, repair, or finish something left undone. Resist both despair and shortcuts. May the Lord establish work done with integrity and make it a blessing to others.
en.quote: Prayer gives courage; faithful hands take the next step.
en.declaration: May the Lord open righteous doors and establish the work of our hands, in Jesus’ name.
morning: O Lord, arise and dismantle every altar of stagnation, in Jesus’ name.
Father, give me wisdom and diligence for today’s work, in Jesus’ name.
Open honest doors that align with Your purpose, in Jesus’ name.
evening: Lord, forgive where I was careless or dishonest, in Jesus’ name.
Every devourer assigned against the fruit of my labour, be scattered, in Jesus’ name.
Establish the work of our hands for good, in Jesus’ name.

yo.title: Jẹ́ kí iná náà máa jó
yo.verse: Léfítíkù 6:13 — Iná lórí pẹpẹ gbọdọ̀ máa jó ní gbogbo ìgbà; kò gbọdọ̀ kú.
message: Iná kì í tàn mọ́lẹ̀ fúnra rẹ̀ láìsí ẹni tó ń tọ́jú rẹ̀. Àlùfáà máa ń tọ́jú pẹpẹ lójoojúmọ́. Òwe Jésù nípa àwọn fìtílà náà sì rán wa létí pé ká múra sílẹ̀ fún dídé Rẹ̀. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìrìn wa pẹ̀lú Ọlọ́run nílò àkíyèsí ojoojúmọ́. Ẹ jẹ́ ká gbàdúrà, ká ka Ọ̀rọ̀ Rẹ̀, ká kúrò nínú ẹ̀ṣẹ̀, ká sì ṣe ohun tí Ó sọ.

Má dúró de ìṣòro kí o tó padà sí ibi àdúrà. Àkókò díẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Ọlọ́run lónìí lè tọ́ ìpinnu àti ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ. Bẹ Ọlọ́run pé kó fi ohun tó ń mú ọkàn rẹ tutù hàn ọ. Sọ òtítọ́ fún Un. Ẹni tó pè wá sí ìṣọ́ra yóò fún wa ní oore-ọ̀fẹ́ láti tẹ̀síwájú.
yo.quote: Ọkàn tí a ń tọ́jú ni ọkàn tí ó múra sílẹ̀.
yo.declaration: Kí ìfẹ́ tuntun sí àdúrà àti ìwà mímọ́ dìde nínú ilé wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Baba, tún ìfẹ́ mi sí Ọ̀rọ̀ Rẹ̀ jí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo ohun tó ń fà mí kúrò níwájú Rẹ, pàdánù agbára rẹ, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Olúwa, fún mi ní oore-ọ̀fẹ́ láti ṣègbọràn sí Ọ lónìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Baba, dárí gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀ àti ìṣe àìṣọ́ra mi lónìí jì mí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Jẹ́ kí ọkàn mi máa ṣọ́ra, kó sì múra sílẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Kí iná ìwàláàyè Rẹ má ṣe kú nínú ilé mi, ní orúkọ Jésù.

yo.title: Nígbà tí ọ̀nà bá dà bí ẹni pé ó ti di
yo.verse: Ẹ́kísódù 14:14 — Olúwa yóò jà fún yín; ẹ̀yin yóò sì dúró ní ìdákẹ́jẹ.
message: Àwọn ọmọ Ísírẹ́lì rí òkun níwájú, wọ́n sì rí ọmọ ogun lẹ́yìn wọn. Ẹ̀rù bá wọn, ṣùgbọ́n Ọlọ́run kò fi wọ́n sílẹ̀. Ó ní kí wọ́n máa lọ síwájú kí wọ́n tó rí ọ̀nà. Ọlọ́run ṣí ọ̀nà níbi tí wọn kò lè ṣí ọ̀nà fúnra wọn.

Ọ̀nà tí ó dà lè mú kí a bẹ̀rù tàbí kí a wá ìtúsílẹ̀ tí kò tọ́. Kọ́kọ́ gbé ọ̀ràn náà lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run. Lẹ́yìn náà, ṣe ìgbésẹ̀ rere tí o lè ṣe. Ìrànlọ́wọ́ Rẹ̀ lè wá nípasẹ̀ ìgboyà, ìmọ̀ràn, ìpèsè tàbí ilẹ̀kùn tuntun. Má jẹ́ kí ẹ̀rù pariwo ju ìlérí Rẹ̀ lọ.
yo.quote: Olúwa lè ṣe ọ̀nà kí o tó rí i.
yo.declaration: Kí gbogbo ìdènà sí ète Ọlọ́run yọ kúrò nípa agbára Rẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Olúwa, dìde kí O sì tú ẹ̀rù tó wà níwájú mi ká, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo pẹpẹ ìdádúró lòdì sí ìlọsíwájú mi, wó lulẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Baba, fi ìgbésẹ̀ tó tọ́ tó kàn hàn mí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Olúwa, dáàbò bo ọkàn mi kúrò nínú ìpayà àti ìpinnu kánkán, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Kí gbogbo ohun tó ń tako ète Rẹ̀ di asán, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Mo sinmi nínú àbójútó Rẹ lálẹ́ yìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.

yo.title: Ọkàn tí a sọ di mímọ́
yo.verse: Sáàmù 51:10 — Ọlọ́run, dá ọkàn mímọ́ sínú mi; tún ẹ̀mí tí ó dúró ṣinṣin ṣe nínú mi.
message: Dáfídì kò fi àwíjàre bo ara rẹ nígbà tó bẹ Ọlọ́run fún àánú. Ó jẹ́wọ́ ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ rẹ, ó sì bẹ Ọlọ́run pé kó tún òun ṣe láti inú. Ìwà mímọ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọkàn olóòótọ́ níwájú Ọlọ́run, kì í ṣe fífi ojú rere hàn ènìyàn.

Olúwa ń pè wá láti jẹ́wọ́ ẹ̀ṣẹ̀, ká yí padà, ká sì gba ìdáríjì. Bẹ Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́ pé kó fi ìwà tó ń dín ìgbọ́ràn rẹ kù hàn ọ. Ṣe àtúnṣe níbi tí o ti ṣẹ ẹlòmíràn. Má gba ohùn tó ń sọ pé ìyípadà kò ṣeé ṣe. Ọlọ́run lè fún wa ní ìfẹ́ tuntun àti ẹ̀mí tó tọ́.
yo.quote: Ọkàn mímọ́ níye ju ojú rere lásán lọ.
yo.declaration: Kí Olúwa wẹ ọkàn wa mọ́, kó sì fi wa múlẹ̀ nínú ìwà mímọ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Baba, ṣàyẹ̀wò ọkàn mi, kí O fi ohun tí kò dùn mọ́ Ọ hàn mí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo ìdè ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀, fọ́ nípa agbára Kristi, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Ọlọ́run, dá ọkàn mímọ́ sínú mi, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Olúwa, dárí ibi tí mo ti ṣìṣe lónìí jì mí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Fún mi ní ìgboyà láti ṣe àtúnṣe, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Tún ẹ̀mí tí ó dúró ṣinṣin ṣe nínú mi, ní orúkọ Jésù.

yo.title: Agbára ní àkókò ìdúró
yo.verse: Àìsáyà 40:31 — Àwọn tí ń dúró de Olúwa yóò ní agbára tuntun.
message: Ìdúró lè dà bí ẹni pé gbogbo ènìyàn ń lọ síwájú, ṣùgbọ́n ìwọ dúró síbẹ̀. Síbẹ̀, Ìwé Mímọ́ sọ pé àwọn tí ń dúró de Olúwa yóò ní agbára tuntun. A ń gbàdúrà, a ń múra sílẹ̀, a ń sìn, a sì ń gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé Ọlọ́run fún ohun tí kò sí lọ́wọ́ wa.

Má fi bí ìdáhùn ṣe ń pẹ́ wọ̀n bí Ọlọ́run ṣe sún mọ́ ọ tó. Ó lè dun ọ́; o lè sọ fún Un. Bẹ fún sùúrù láìsí ìbínú àti ọgbọ́n fún iṣẹ́ òní. Gbogbo ìgbésẹ̀ ìgbọ́ràn kékeré ń rán ọ létí pé ìtàn rẹ ṣì wà lọ́wọ́ Rẹ̀.
yo.quote: Ìdúró pẹ̀lú Ọlọ́run kì í ṣòfò.
yo.declaration: Kí àwọn ọkàn tí ó rẹ̀ gba agbára tuntun lónìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Gbogbo ẹ̀mí ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì, tú mi sílẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Baba, tún agbára mi ṣe bí mo ti ń dúró de Ọ, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Kí ìrètí tún dìde nínú ọkàn mi, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Olúwa, mú ìrònú àníyàn mi balẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo agbára tó ń tì mí sí ọ̀nà abuja tó lè pa mí lára, tú ká, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Kọ́ mi láti gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé àkókò Rẹ, ní orúkọ Jésù.

yo.title: Agbára ìṣọ̀kan
yo.verse: Mátíù 18:20 — Níbi tí ẹni méjì tàbí mẹ́ta bá péjọ ní orúkọ Mi, Èmi wà láàárín wọn.
message: Àwọn onígbàgbọ́ àkọ́kọ́ fi ara wọn fún ẹ̀kọ́, ìbáṣepọ̀, pípín oúnjẹ àti àdúrà. Ìgbésí ayé wọn pọ̀ mú wọn lágbára. Ọlọ́run kò dá wa láti máa ru gbogbo ẹrù wa nìkan. A nílò ìjọ tí ń jọ sìn, tí ń sọ òtítọ́ nínú ìfẹ́.

Pe ẹnìkan nínú ìjọ lónìí. Gba ẹni tí kò tíì wá fún ìgbà díẹ̀ níyànjú. Gbàdúrà fún ìdílé mìíràn. Ìjọ ń lágbára nígbà tí gbogbo wa bá fi àánú àti ìrànlọ́wọ́ hàn, kì í ṣe nípa wíwá sí ìpàdé nìkan. Bẹ Olúwa pé kó jẹ́ kí Mount Zion jẹ́ ilé tí a ti ń rí ènìyàn, tí a sì ń ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́.
yo.quote: Ìjọ tí ń gbàdúrà ń gba ẹrù gbogbo ènìyàn.
yo.declaration: Kí ìfẹ́, ìṣọ̀kan àti agbára Ọlọ́run pọ̀ sí i láàárín wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Gbogbo irúgbìn ìpínyà nínú ìjọ wa, fà tu, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Baba, so ọkàn wa pọ̀ nínú ìfẹ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Jẹ́ kí n jẹ́ olùfúnni ní ìgboyà fún ẹlòmíràn lónìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Olúwa, rántí àwọn tí wọ́n wà ní ìdánìkanwà tàbí ìrora, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Jẹ́ kí àdúrà wa mú àánú àti iṣẹ́ rere wá, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Fi àlàáfíà múlẹ̀ nínú gbogbo ilé tó wà nínú ìjọ wa, ní orúkọ Jésù.

yo.title: Àánú fún òwúrọ̀ tuntun
yo.verse: Ìdárò 3:23 — Àánú Rẹ̀ jẹ́ tuntun ní gbogbo òwúrọ̀; ìṣòtítọ́ Rẹ̀ pọ̀.
message: Àná lè ti mú àdánù, ìjákulẹ̀ tàbí ìpinnu tí o kábàámọ̀ wá. Wòlíì náà rántí ìpọ́njú rẹ, ṣùgbọ́n ó tún rántí àánú Olúwa tí kò lópìn. Ní àárín ìṣòro, ó rí ìdí láti ní ìrètí.

Òwúrọ̀ tuntun kò pa gbogbo àbájáde ohun tó ti ṣẹlẹ̀ rẹ́. Ṣùgbọ́n ó fún wa ní àǹfààní tuntun láti yí sí Ọlọ́run àti láti ṣe ohun tó tọ́. Gba àánú Rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọpẹ́. Wá àlàáfíà níbi tó yẹ; béèrè fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ níbi tí ẹrù bá wuwo. Olúwa ṣì jẹ́ olóòótọ́ bí Ó ti ń kọ́ wa láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
yo.quote: Àánú ń pàdé wa kí iṣẹ́ ọjọ́ tó bẹ̀rẹ̀.
yo.declaration: Kí àánú Ọlọ́run sọ̀rọ̀ lórí gbogbo ilé tí ìṣòro ń bá, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Baba, mo dúpẹ́ fún àánú tuntun òwúrọ̀ yìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo ohùn ìdálẹ́bi tó ń dí àdúrà mi lọ́wọ́, fọ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Tọ́ ìgbésẹ̀ mi sí ìgbọ́ràn lónìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Olúwa, ràn mí lọ́wọ́ láti fi ẹrù tí n kò lè ru sílẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Kí àánú àti ìwòsàn wọ inú ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó bàjẹ́, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Pa ìrètí mi mọ́ nínú ìṣòtítọ́ Rẹ, ní orúkọ Jésù.

yo.title: Ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ olóòótọ́
yo.verse: Sáàmù 90:17 — Fi iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ wa múlẹ̀ fún wa.
message: Nehémíà gbàdúrà, ó wo ògiri tó wó, ó sì pe àwọn ènìyàn láti kọ́ ọ́ padà. Ìgbàgbọ́ kò yọ ìmúrasílẹ̀ àti iṣẹ́ kúrò; ó fún un ní ìgboyà láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ iṣẹ́ tó wà níwájú rẹ.

Gbé iṣẹ́, ẹ̀kọ́, òwò àti wíwá iṣẹ́ rẹ lọ sọ́dọ̀ Ọlọ́run. Bẹ fún àǹfààní olóòótọ́ àti ìtara. Yan ohun rere kan tí o lè ṣe lónìí: múra sílẹ̀, kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́, fi ìbéèrè iṣẹ́ sílẹ̀, tún ohun kan ṣe tàbí parí iṣẹ́ tí o bẹ̀rẹ̀. Kọ ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì àti ọ̀nà abuja. Kí Olúwa fi iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ wa múlẹ̀ kí ó sì jẹ́ ìbùkún fún àwọn ẹlòmíràn.
yo.quote: Àdúrà ń fúnni ní ìgboyà; ọwọ́ olóòótọ́ ń gbé ìgbésẹ̀ tó kàn.
yo.declaration: Kí Olúwa ṣí ilẹ̀kùn rere, kó sì fi iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ wa múlẹ̀, ní orúkọ Jésù.
morning: Olúwa, dìde kí O sì wó gbogbo pẹpẹ ìdúró ṣinṣin, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Baba, fún mi ní ọgbọ́n àti ìtara fún iṣẹ́ òní, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Ṣí ilẹ̀kùn olóòótọ́ tó bá ète Rẹ mu, ní orúkọ Jésù.
evening: Olúwa, dárí ibi tí mo ti ṣe àìṣọ́ra tàbí àìṣòtítọ́ jì mí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo agbára tó ń jẹ èso iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ mi run, tú ká, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Fi iṣẹ́ ọwọ́ wa múlẹ̀ fún rere, ní orúkọ Jésù.

en: Break the yoke
Command divine provision
Walk in stewardship
yo: Fọ́ àjàgà àìní
Bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ìpèsè Ọlọ́run
Lo ìbùkún pẹ̀lú ọgbọ́n

en: O Lord, arise and dismantle every altar of financial delay, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every chain of debt and lack assigned against my life, catch fire and be consumed, in Jesus’ name.
I command every devourer attacking the work of my hands to scatter by the power in the blood of Jesus.
Every door of waste in my household, be broken now, in the name of Jesus.
Father, expose and uproot every evil covenant of poverty, in Jesus’ name.
By the fire of the Holy Ghost, let every pattern of fruitless labour lose its hold, in Jesus’ name.
I reject every power burying my opportunities; I receive freedom through Jesus Christ.
Every hand of stagnation over my income working in secret, be exposed and defeated, in Jesus’ name.
O Lord, arise and scatter every voice speaking failure over my work, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I declare that every trap of dishonest gain has no dominion over my life, in Jesus’ name.
Let the power of God overturn every spirit of fear concerning provision, in Jesus’ name.
Every cycle of loss and disappointment standing at the door of my breakthrough, give way now, in Jesus’ name.
I renounce every obstacle blocking rightful opportunities and stand on the victory of Christ.
Father, let every burden that steals peace from my home be uprooted completely, in Jesus’ name.
Father, release wisdom to manage what You provide, in the mighty name of Jesus.
O Lord, open the heavens and grant honest doors of income and fruitful work, in Jesus’ name.
I receive provision for the needs of my household by Your grace, in the name of Jesus.
Father, let Your favour bring favour with the right helpers and opportunities, in Jesus’ name.
By Your mercy, establish grace to give generously without fear, in the mighty name of Jesus.
O Lord, pour out restoration where hardship has taken much upon our lives, in Jesus’ name.
Let Your power bring forth peace and testimony over my finances, for Your glory, in Jesus’ name.

Mo pàṣẹ fún gbogbo agbára tó ń dí ìṣòro owó lọ́wọ́ láti tú ká nípa agbára ẹ̀jẹ̀ Jésù.

Mo kọ gbogbo ìdènà sí ìṣòro owó; mo gba ìtúsílẹ̀ mi nípasẹ̀ Kristi Jésù.
Gbogbo ìdàrúdàpọ̀ tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lòdì sí ìṣòro owó, fọ́ ká kí o sì ṣẹ́gun, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Olúwa, dìde kí O sì tú gbogbo ìkọlù sí ìṣòro owó ká, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Mo kéde pé kò sí ìdẹkùn tí yóò ṣàkóso ìṣòro owó mi, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Kí agbára Ọlọ́run yí gbogbo ìṣòro ìṣòro owó padà sí ẹ̀rí rere, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Gbogbo ohun tó ń dí ìlọsíwájú mi nínú ìṣòro owó lọ́wọ́, fà sẹ́yìn báyìí, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Mo kọ ọ̀nà àìṣòótọ́ àti ohun gbogbo tó ń dá ìṣòro owó dúró; mo dúró nínú ìṣẹ́gun Kristi.
Baba, fà gbogbo ẹrù tó ń gba àlàáfíà mi lórí ìṣòro owó tu, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Baba, fún mi ní ọgbọ́n láti ṣe ìpinnu tó tọ́ nípa ìṣòro owó, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Olúwa, ṣí ilẹ̀kùn tó tọ́ sí ìṣòro owó, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Mo gba ìrànlọ́wọ́ àti oore-ọ̀fẹ́ Rẹ fún ìṣòro owó, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Baba, jẹ́ kí ojú rere Rẹ mú àwọn olùrànlọ́wọ́ àti àǹfààní tòótọ́ wá nípa ìṣòro owó, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Nípa àánú Rẹ, fún mi ní agbára láti dúró ṣinṣin nígbà tí mo ń dúró de ìdáhùn nípa ìṣòro owó, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Olúwa, mú ìrètí àti ìdáhùn tuntun wá nípa ìṣòro owó, ní orúkọ Jésù.
Jẹ́ kí agbára Rẹ mú àlàáfíà àti ẹ̀rí rere wá sí ayé mi nípa ìṣòro owó, fún ògo Rẹ, ní orúkọ Jésù.

en: Break confusion
Command understanding
Finish with excellence
yo: Fọ́ ìdàrúdàpọ̀
Bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún òye

en: Break delay
Open the right doors
Establish the work

Ṣí ilẹ̀kùn rere
Fi iṣẹ́ múlẹ̀

Father, expose and uproot every evil voice of defeat after interviews, in Jesus’ name.

I reject every trap of exploitative work; I receive freedom through Jesus Christ.
Every cloud of confusion over my next step working in secret, be exposed and defeated, in Jesus’ name.
O Lord, arise and scatter every attack on my confidence and preparation, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I declare that every door of dishonest opportunity has no dominion over my life, in Jesus’ name.

Father, let every power resisting the work of my hands be uprooted completely, in Jesus’ name.
